name: PING: Physicists Inspiring the Next Generation (FRIB, Michigan State University)
org: Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB), Michigan State University
what_you_do: Spend two weeks learning nuclear physics at the FRIB lab with college mentors. It can turn into a year-long project you present at conferences.
who_can_apply: Grades 9 to 11 at a U.S. high school (including U.S. territories). You need a reference from a teacher or coach.
pay_detail: No cost. Housing, meals and a flight for out-of-state students are covered.
duration: 2 weeks in summer (2026: July 12 to 25, online)
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was Mar 15, 2026. The 2027 deadline is not posted. Decisions come by May 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply on nsbping.org when the 2027 form is posted. Name a teacher or coach as your reference. Questions: ping@frib.msu.edu.
notes: 2027 takes grades 9 to 11, not 12. PING 2026 ran online, so check how 2027 will run.
